title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity bump v1.20.0
author: Taylor Nguyen
description: Motivation: unify authentication and retry behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, improve streaming API ergonomics (backpressure and cancellation), close parity gaps in method names and behaviors, and prepare release v1.20.0. This PR consolidates the shared auth stack, centralizes retry policies, standardizes streaming helpers, and bumps SDK package versions. High-level changes: 1) Introduce shared auth middleware used by all SDKs with clearer token refresh hooks and deterministic header ordering for signing; 2) Extract retry policy primitives (exponential backoff jitter, retryable error classification) into a common design and adopt identical default parameters across languages; 3) Streaming ergonomics: add simpler client-side abort/cancel API, expose per-chunk metadata, and ensure consistent error propagation when the server closes streams early; 4) Parity fixes: rename methods for TS/Go to match Python ergonomics (send_stream -> stream_write), align default timeout semantics, and add missing error codes mapping; 5) Version bumps: Python 1.20.0, TypeScript 1.20.0, Go v1.20.0; updated release notes and changelogs. Testing: unit and integration tests added for retry policy, token refresh race conditions, and streaming cancellation. CI: flakiness observed on initial run due to streaming integration tests; rerun succeeded. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-1987) - [x] Tests added/updated - [x] TypeScript types and Go interfaces updated - [x] Docs/changelog updated - [x] Version bumps for all SDKs - [x] Post-merge smoke tests scheduled Related issues: Linear ENG-1987, ENG-2042. See changelog link: https://internal.redwood.dev/changelog/v1.20.0
commits: feat(sdk-common): add shared auth middleware with refresh hook
refactor(python): move retry policy into redwood.sdk.common.retry
feat(typescript): expose simplified streaming.cancel() API and per-chunk meta
fix(go): map transport error codes to SDK error types
test(sdk): add integration test for streaming cancellation race
chore(release): bump python/ts/go versions to v1.20.0
review_comments: Samir Patel: Overall looks solid. A few suggestions: 1) consider exposing retry jitter seed for deterministic tests; 2) clarify error mapping in go/retry.go. Please add small comment explaining the choice for default maxRetries.
Taylor Nguyen: Thanks Samir — added jitter seed option behind a test-only flag and documented the rationale in comments. Also updated go/retry.go to use mapping table and added unit tests.
Olivia Park: Streaming ergonomics change is great, but can we ensure the typescript types export both cancel() and abortSignal patterns? Some customers rely on AbortSignal.
Taylor Nguyen: Good call — exported both patterns. Updated streaming.ts and added a migration note in the changelog.
Maya Thompson: CI flake observed on macOS runner for streaming test: seems timing-sensitive. Can we add a short retry wrapper around that test to reduce flakes?
Taylor Nguyen: Added a retry wrapper with exponential backoff to the flaky integration test. Reran CI — all checks passed.
Release Manager (automated): Release checklist completed — packages built for python/ts/go and artifacts uploaded to internal registry.
release_notes: SDKs: Unify auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go; improve streaming client ergonomics (cancel/abort, per-chunk metadata); fix parity gaps in method names and error mappings; bump SDK versions to v1.20.0. See changelog for migration notes and upgraded default retry parameters.
